agents.reasoning: Round 2. Valued only the remaining Climate Solutions company. I accepted and verified three supervisor findings against primary filings: (a) Q1 FY27 corporate & eliminations was -$23.0M in one quarter (src 23), so my round-1 -$40M/yr was too light; I now use -$80M to -$85M; (b) the 10-K says one global technology customer was ~11% of consolidated FY26 sales and top-10 were 49% (src 25), which I use instead of leak-based shares; (c) the Nov 18 Investor Day exists (src 26) and the Q2 report is unannounced but very likely ~Oct 26-29. I also verified the Q1 slides' DC 'earnings growth in excess of 85%' guide (src 24) and stay ~$27M below it (judgment after the Q1 margin miss). Net debt: verified $432.9M at Jun-30 and the $156M distribution; the Gentherm 8-K confirms a separate Cash Transfer was funded (src 30) but not its size, so ~$280M at close is an estimate; with Q1 FCF -$5M and $150-200M capex I cut 12-month FCF to ~$120M (net debt ~$160M at horizon). Peers: dropped Daikin and Munters (different fiscal/consensus basis; Daikin's 7.7x was a basis artifact), leaving 10 peers on one formula: medians 17.9x EV/EBITDA and 27.6x P/E; I withdrew the round-1 premium and apply a ~5% discount for contractually persistent concentration. Result: EBITDA FY27/28/29 $462M/$625M/$734M, NTM at horizon $680M; EV/EBITDA $211 and P/E $213, fair value $212 (from $230); scenario mean ~$215. Alt-lane evidence: Hunterbrook leak still used only as bull-case colour; plant hiring/capacity trackers (src 13, 15, 29) confirm the build-out is real; the 11.5% Sep 28 record-date drop (src 28) looks like spin mechanics. Because execution has missed twice and the market capitalises ~18x my near-term EBITDA, I shade the ladder median to ~$196 (about halfway from $183 to fair value), lognormal sigma ~0.52 with a slightly fatter left tail and a thinner right tail than round 1 (P>=320 0.155 vs 0.205; P>=457 0.04 vs 0.065), consistent with a bull case that needs ~21x on ~$820M. Research limits: sec.gov blocked direct downloads (filings read via WebFetch; EDGAR JSON index fetched directly); X/Reddit not reachable via search. Lane share fell further (~40%) because the supervisor's findings required primary-filing verification.

DC +40% to $2.59B at 19.5% = $505M; CHVAC +7% to $1.13B at 16.5% = $187M; corporate -$82M. DC growth is below management's 50-70% two-year view. It is supported by the $4B CY27-29 capacity agreement (10-K [33]: 'more than $4 billion ... during calendar years 2027 through 2029'; ~$1.33B/yr = $4B / 3, an estimate) and the internal base case of 2027 customer AI capex +50% [16].

On a revenue-CAGR divisor the median is 20.73x and on the average divisor 20.23x. Taking ~20.23x as the reconciled midpoint, 17.5x is a ~13% discount and sits inside the range. The discount rests on persistent factors: one customer is ~11% of consolidated sales, ~30% of DC if all DC (estimate from [33]: 0.11 x $3,181.1M / $1,108.2M), and the $4B agreement runs through CY2029; DC margin is 19.4% in FY26 and 14.8% in Q1 versus VRT/NVT at ~22% (TTM GAAP EBITDA margins to 2026-06-30, 10-Q XBRL); and repeated supply-driven misses [7,30].
